info.name: Astitva API
info.description: Astitva REST API collection for local Dev and Stage profiles and the Render Production profile. Diet includes F008 water tracking, Meal Library, and CSV preview/import.

request.description: Production browser login returns sessionToken alongside the HTTP-only cookie. Protected requests may use Authorization: Bearer <sessionToken>. The user response includes feature flags from invitedEmails; missing flags default to Family only. Never log or share the token. For native iOS login: remove Origin, disable the cookie jar, add X-Astitva-Client: ios, and keep Content-Type: application/json. The response returns sessionToken without setting a session cookie. Native authenticated writes use X-Astitva-Client: ios and Authorization: Bearer <sessionToken>, with no Origin or Cookie.
Disable cookie jar in request Settings. Do not send Origin, Cookie, or Authorization. Login returns sessionToken. Store it in a local sessionToken variable for subsequent bearer requests.
Copy the token query parameter from the verification link shown in Mailpit.

item.name: Daily Priorities (F009)
item.description: Use a verified login session and a current/past priorityDate. X-Time-Zone is required. Add three rows then attempt a fourth for 409; completed rows still occupy slots. Missing/expired session gives 401; an unverified login gives 403. DELETE twice gives 404 on repeat. Refetch after each change. Concurrent race checks: ASTITVA_TEST_PRIORITIES=1 npm test in server/. Fixture cleanup targets only generated test users. Never auto-retry uncertain adds.

Admin Panel (F031)
item.description: Log in as the verified ADMIN_EMAILS account using Postman bearer login first. Set adminSearch and adminInviteEmail. Copy a search result ID into adminUserId and fetch the user before editing. Responses capture versions; a stale edit returns 409. Existing users allow feature edits only. Creating an invitee sends email; delivery failures preserve access and permit retry. Origin uses the configured webUrl.

item.name: Notifications (F032)
item.description: Disable the cookie jar. Never share populated device tokens. Refresh registration before two days of inactivity and deregister before logout. Use only fixtures for automated tests.
